items.html: And when the second king reigned, who is Hesed, he drew forth the five Hassadim to expand into the Guf of Abba, as is known. And when he died, he fell into Beria, and the five lights came down into Gevura in the third king. Then the backs of Abba fell, which were made through the expansion of the five Hassadim mentioned above, and now they all fell, and the Hassadim came down into Yesod of Abba. Then Abba turned his backs to the face of Bina, and this aspect is called “back within face,” because the face of Bina stands opposite the backs of Hochma.
